spatial_summary.scope: Public federation GeoParquet modified 2026-10-11; BW bounding rectangle [7.50,47.50,10.50,49.80], matched only to registry DE:310/DE:311 points. Not a current complete catalogue census.

limitations: Exploratory replay of the repository SGBlur YOLO11n baseline, not a replay of the exact source server model/version.
Assistant-proposed target boxes are partial and need human approval. No precision, mAP or population recall can be inferred.
No classifier was run; this detector only predicts sign, plate and face.
No training or model selection was performed. These examples are exploratory discovery material, not a blinded holdout.

novelty_scope: 154 lecture images from 48 sequences and the earlier discovery cache of 3,745 image IDs from 298 sequences. Not a complete model-pretraining-corpus audit. All retained frames/sequences and checked file hashes are absent from this scoped inventory.
